title: Something worth remembering that needs no action
description: Also carries decisions: a note with a project is what used to be a line in that project's LOG.md. A note belonging to a project is archived with it; others stay until archived by hand.

project.description: Scopes the note to a project. Project-scoped notes in date order are that project's decision log.

paths.description: Files or directories this concerns, absolute. Replaces the former resource type.
